svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, C++. Web and mobile: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Jetpack Compose, Android. Backend and data: FastAPI, Fastify, Node.js, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, MongoDB. AI and ML: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, OpenCV, pandas, Streamlit. Shipping: Docker, Git, Vercel, Twilio.
